steps.step: Author set up: Asha invited, legacy active, two approved items (one with a recording) and one draft
Recipient joins and sees nothing shared yet (AC-02)
Author shares one item with Asha
Recipient sees only the shared item, its words and its recording; no draft or unshared item
Recipient can play the shared original
Recipient question answered in Dad's own words, with the AI disclosure
An approved item that was not shared is never used
Author is told about the report
Report shows reason, note, question (included by choice) and the source item
Author's log shows sharing, views, plays and answers, without the recipient's questions
An edited (draft) item disappears for the recipient at once
Re-approved item is visible again with the new words
After 'Stop sharing everything', the recipient sees nothing
The recording can no longer be fetched
